University at the Table

A quiet 60-second gathering around God’s Word

You’re already welcome here—print what helps; skip the rest without guilt.

For weary days when you want something short to read together at the table, in the car, or before bed. No pressure. Just a few lamps along the path.

One verse from each quiet room

When anxiety feels loud

Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

— John 14:27 (KJV)

When the tank is empty

Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

— Matthew 11:28 (KJV)

When little ones still need you

And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.

— Isaiah 54:13 (KJV)

When gratitude feels hard but you still reach for it

This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

— Psalm 118:24 (KJV)

60-second family aloud

One person reads the lines below slowly—the rest can listen or whisper “Amen.”

  1. Lord, our hearts are sometimes troubled and weary.
  2. Thank You for Your peace that the world cannot give.
  3. Thank You that we can come to You and find rest.
  4. Teach our children and give us all great peace.
  5. We rejoice in this day You have made.

Amen.

Print, fold, keep on the fridge or in the car. Same gentle pace. KJV only.
